'''2011 US Nationals Peter Jacobson LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Peter Jacobson]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Peter Jacobson (Jeeps)
* '''Deck name:''' Poop Slaps?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
